claim.claim-text: 1. A polypeptide comprising a first fragment and a second fragment, wherein
2. The polypeptide of claim 1 wherein the polypeptide elicits a protective immune response in a mammalian host against strains of C.difficile.
3. The polypeptide of any one of claims 1-2 wherein the first fragment and/or the second fragment comprise less than 25%, 20%, 18% or 15% alpha helical structure.
4. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the first fragment and/or the second fragment comprise more than 25%, 30%, 35%, 38% or 40% beta sheet structure.
5. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the first proximal end is within a short repeat.
6. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the second proximal end is within a short repeat.
7. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the first proximal end does not disrupt a short repeat-long repeat-short repeat portion.
8. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the second proximal end does not disrupt a short repeat-long repeat-short repeat portion.
9. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the first proximal end and the second proximal end do not disrupt short repeat-long repeat-short repeat portions.
10. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the first proximal end is not within amino acids 1878-1940, 2012-2074, 2146-2208, 2258-2322, 2394-2456, 2507-2569 or 2598-2660 of toxin A.
11. The polypeptide of any preceding claim wherein the second proximal end is not within amino acids 1881-1942, 2012-2074, 2144-2208 or 2278-2339 of toxin B.
12. A polynucleotide encoding the polypeptide of any one of claims 1-11.
13. An immunogenic composition comprising the polypeptide of any one of claims 1-11 and a pharmaceutically acceptable excipient.
14. The immunogenic composition of claim 13 further comprising an adjuvant.
15. A use of the immunogenic composition of any one of claims 13-14 in the treatment or prevention of C.difficile disease.
